items.title: Manuel Mello Interview, 1959-08-03
items.q: I heard Brad Stecker, the oldest trumpet player in the city right now.

ctx.x: I heard Brad Stecker, the oldest trumpet player in the city right now. He was, uh, he used to play with, uh, I used to do a little reporting for the International Jazz. That's a year, four years back. And, uh, they used to rehearse once a week on a Wednesday night. On. With a good Betholome in there. Dolphine. And I used to go there. Well, my daddy was a pretty good friend of Shanks. And, uh, I used to go over there and listen to him. Now, I'll say this for Bat Steckler. He could do what I couldn't do. Bat…
What were their names? Sheik was one of them?
